integration.description: The ShopPrompter® JavaScript SDK adds the AI shopping assistant to any website as a framework-agnostic Web Component: plain HTML, Shopify, WordPress, Angular, Svelte and every other stack that renders HTML.
integration.overview:
Add the `<shop-prompter>` element to your shop, either from a CDN without a build step or via npm. It works with every framework and renders in Shadow DOM, so your shops styles and the assistants styles never interfere.

Choose between a chat bubble, a dialog, a side panel or a full-page chat, adapt colors and fonts to your brand, and react to cart operations and product clicks to connect the assistant to your cart and product pages.

prerequisites.title: A modern browser with Web Components support (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)
A ShopPrompter® API key or token
